description: hotmaps is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Biomass potentials > hotmaps", published or maintained by gitlab.com (publisher inferred from the link). Lead by EURAC. Covers EU28, resolved down to NUTS3. Feedstocks are forestry residues, agricultural residues, livestock effluent and municipal solid waste. Data available as CSV. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Biomass potentials" lists it under "hotmaps". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support biomass potential inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
licence: not stated on the wiki page (source page not read)
